about: A manifest whose engines.vizi this protocol (1.0) cannot run is refused for that, before any other check. Each case is run through the reference parser (scripts/check_manifest_fixtures.py) and through the Go, Rust and Java parsers' tests. expected.kind is 'engines_incompatible' (the distinct error, its message exactly expected.message), 'invalid' (any other refusal, its message containing expected.message) or 'accepted'.

cases.name: a newer minor is refused for engines, not for the widget kind it added

expected.message: Widgets 1.2.0 needs vizi protocol 1.1; this vizi speaks 1.0

cases.name: a newer major is refused even when the rest is valid

expected.message: Next 3 needs vizi protocol 2.0; this vizi speaks 1.0
Old 0.4 needs vizi protocol 0.9; this vizi speaks 1.0

cases.name: engines is read before manifest_version, and quoted as written

expected.message: Later 1 needs vizi protocol ^1.3; this vizi speaks 1.0

cases.name: the sentence names the id when the name is missing

expected.message: org.example.anon 1 needs vizi protocol 1.1; this vizi speaks 1.0

cases.name: a compatible engines takes the normal path: the unknown widget kind
a malformed engines string is also refused first, as an invalid manifest
an engines.vizi that is not a string is an invalid manifest, not an engines refusal
an omitted engines reads as 1.0 and takes the normal order
an omitted engines is accepted as 1.0
a present engines without vizi is refused in the normal order
